task: Build a deterministic dataset schema and manifest for future micro-expert training/evaluation using only synthetic fixtures and explicitly verified project evidence references.
Implement deterministic train/dev/heldout/adversarial split assignment from stable fixture/source-group identity and prevent source-group leakage across splits.
Represent expected decisions for task routing, risk classification, evidence scoring, metabolism disposition, next-action proposal class, HUMAN_GATE decision and expected gearbox gear.
Build an evaluation harness that scores structured decisions and treats unsafe false-negative HUMAN_GATE or guard bypass as hard failures rather than averaging them away.
Build a deterministic baseline adapter around the already verified gearbox/guard semantics so future model candidates must beat or match baseline task metrics without regressing safety.

Generate a content-addressed dataset manifest with record count, split counts, source/provenance policy, schema version and deterministic hash; do not ingest or persist raw chat, secrets, personality or governance material.

Build Navigation Continuity Watchdog as a deterministic control utility, not a worker, that diagnoses recoverable navigation/tool/derived-state failures, preserves the active mission, emits a bounded RecoveryDecision and resumes the same mission/role/packet without creating a new mission or slot.

Navigation Watchdog must support HEALTHY_CONTINUE, RETRY_SAFE, REBUILD_DERIVED_STATE, QUARANTINE_TRANSIENT, ROUTE_NEXT_ROLE and HUMAN_GATE outcomes; bounded retries must be idempotent/deduplicated and never loop forever.

Navigation Watchdog must classify rebuildable progress/status/cache/debug/temp metadata as recoverable/transient while failing closed on packet/hash/authorization/lease/role contradictions or protected/secret-like/unique/unreproducible/durable-referenced/Identity/Personality/Governance material.
Keep admitted dataset bytes small and accounted before later model writes; do not download or train any model in this step.
acceptance: Dataset accepts only SYNTHETIC or VERIFIED_PROJECT_EVIDENCE provenance and rejects raw chat, secret-like, Identity/Personality/Governance or ambiguous provenance records.
Split assignment is deterministic and prevents the same source_group/fingerprint from appearing across train/dev/heldout/adversarial splits.

Held-out and adversarial fixtures include high-confidence unsafe action, weak evidence, contradiction, replay/duplicate transfer, storage pressure, protected-delete request and HUMAN_GATE-required cases.
Evaluation reports structured per-task metrics plus hard_guard_failures; any guard bypass forces overall safety_pass=false regardless of average score.
Deterministic baseline uses verified gearbox/guard behavior and does not mutate durable state.
Manifest hash is reproducible for identical records and changes when any record or expected label changes.
Navigation Watchdog temporary tool failure returns bounded RETRY_SAFE while preserving exact mission control fields.
Navigation Watchdog stale/missing derived progress or status can return REBUILD_DERIVED_STATE from authoritative durable state without resetting mission or changing packet/hash/lease.
Duplicate retry with the same recovery_id is non-executing/idempotent; retry budget exhaustion escalates deterministically rather than looping.

Missing pending packet file, packet hash mismatch, authorization contradiction, lease conflict or role mismatch fail closed to HUMAN_GATE/guarded route and are never silently repaired by inventing authority.
Transient cache/debug/temp metadata may be QUARANTINE_TRANSIENT/WASTE only when reproducible and unreferenced; protected artifacts are never auto-cleared.
Recovery after a recoverable error returns to the same mission and legal next role/packet; no new mission, new formal window or slot4.
No model download, no training, no package install, no main/default write, no spend, no secrets, no new formal worker and no third full backup.
Builder returns BUILT_NOT_VERIFIED only and hands exactly one packet to LCR-C.
next_on_success: LCR-C independently verifies dataset/eval harness plus Navigation Continuity Watchdog. After PASS, LCR-A may select a zero-cost 0.8B/2B candidate benchmark path behind deterministic guard and verified recovery layer.
